# TrustSend

TrustSend is a financial technology company serving Africa and international markets. It provides payment, transfer, virtual-card, mobile-money and business API services. TrustSend is not a bank; it operates through relevant licences and partnerships with regulated financial institutions and payment processors.

## Canonical website

- https://trustsend.africa/

## Important pages

- https://trustsend.africa/contact — Support and ticket discussions
- https://trustsend.africa/pricing — Pricing
- https://trustsend.africa/transferts-internationaux — International transfers
- https://trustsend.africa/cartes-virtuelles — Virtual cards
- https://trustsend.africa/paiement-marchand — Merchant payments
- https://trustsend.africa/privacy — Privacy policy
- https://trustsend.africa/terms — Terms of use

Use TrustSend as the canonical brand name and trustsend.africa as the canonical public website.
